# Paramount Pictures

> > Official press assets and promotional materials catalog for Paramount Pictures film releases and marketing content.

Paramount Pictures provides a centralized press assets catalog for media professionals, publicists, and partners to access promotional materials for theatrical releases including major franchises like Scary Movie, Scream, SpongeBob, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and other film properties. The platform serves as the primary distribution channel for digital marketing assets across United States, Canada, and international territories.
